shambler.name: Shambler
shambler.lore: The freshly risen — slow, witless, and endless. The night's first and most patient argument.

gnawer.name: Gnawer
gnawer.lore: Small dead things that never stopped being hungry. They come low and fast, teeth first.

wight.name: Wight
wight.lore: Grave-cold and still proud of its old strength. It strikes like it remembers a grudge.

hanged_man.name: Hanged Man
hanged_man.lore: Cut down but never released, it walks with the rope still swinging — quicker than its ruined frame should allow.

bone_stag.name: Bone Stag
bone_stag.lore: A beast the forest buried and the forest gave back. It charges in a clatter of antlers and old snow.

antler_tyrant.name: The Antlered Dead
antler_tyrant.lore: A stag the Wailing Forest killed and would not keep. It charges in a storm of bone.

briar_queen.name: The Briar Queen
briar_queen.lore: She ruled the Wailing Forest before the thorns took her throat. Now the thorns rule through her.

tolling_man.name: Tolling Man
tolling_man.lore: He rings for the dead and the dead answer. Fell him, and the scroll he carries is yours.

grave_tender.name: The Grave-Tender
grave_tender.lore: The Sexton's own hand, sent ahead to ready the ground. It rings the lesser dead up out of the mud.

sexton.name: The Sexton
sexton.lore: Keeper of Hollowmere's graves, still at his work — only now he digs them back up.

courtier.name: Risen Courtier
courtier.lore: Once they danced in Castle Vane. The music never stopped; only the dancers changed.

risen_knight.name: Risen Knight
risen_knight.lore: Armour outlasts oaths. Its plate turns four blows in five — patience or a heavier weapon undoes it.

iron_revenant.name: The Iron Revenant
iron_revenant.lore: A knight of Castle Vane who never yielded, and death did not change that. Its plate turns all but the heaviest blow.

crypt_archer.name: Crypt Archer
crypt_archer.lore: It holds its distance and looses from the dark. Close the gap, or learn to read the drawn string.

chorister.name: Chapel Chorister
chorister.lore: Its hymn knits its kin whole again. Silence the singer before you tire of killing the same dead twice.

chapel_thing.name: The Thing in the Chapel
chapel_thing.lore: What knelt too long at a broken altar, and answered when something knelt back. Its prayers come in volleys.

carrion_crow.name: Carrion Crow
carrion_crow.lore: They feasted on the field-dead and forgot how to stop. A black tide on tattered wings.

barrow_brute.name: Barrow Brute
barrow_brute.lore: What they buried under the biggest stone, and the biggest stone was not enough.

bloat.name: Bloat
bloat.lore: Swollen with the gas of its own rot. Put it down at arm's length, or share in the burst.

sundered_wisp.name: Sundered Wisp
sundered_wisp.lore: One grief that will not be one thing. Cut it and it is two, each still hungry.
